description: Header file defining the metrics_manager class, which manages metrics registration, notification, and periodic reporting within the ocudu::app_services namespace.

classes.name: metrics_manager
classes.description: Manages registration, notification, and periodic reporting of metrics, including handling producers and consumers.

methods.name: metrics_manager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the metrics manager with configuration, logger, executor, timers, and report period.

methods.name: on_new_metric
methods.description: Handles incoming metrics, forwarding them to registered consumers if applicable.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the periodic metrics report controller.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the periodic metrics report controller and the stop event source.
